ordersEmail.title: Order intake email
ordersEmail.explanation: Connect the dedicated Gmail inbox that receives supplier purchase orders. The app checks it every 5 minutes for new emails with a PDF attachment, extracts the order date, ordering organization, and PO number from the document, and adds it to the Orders list automatically. This uses a Gmail app password, not the account's real login password — generate one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (2-Step Verification must be turned on for that Google account first).
ordersEmail.appPasswordKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current one
ordersEmail.notifyOnComplete: Email the finished order when a delivery note is added
ordersEmail.notifyExplanation: Sends the completed PDF (PO + delivery note) to the addresses below as soon as an order is marked done. The subject line is the generated filename (e.g. "2026-07-15 - Company Ltd - רכש 1234 - תמ 5678.pdf").
ordersEmail.storageHint: Which storage connection the PDF attachment from each incoming order gets saved to. Same setting as the "Orders" row on the Storage Routing page — shown here too for convenience.

calls.title: Calls

calls.noSessions: No one has pressed "In progress" yet.

storage.title: Storage connections
storage.synologyHttps: HTTPS (DSM WebDAV default ports: 5005 HTTP / 5006 HTTPS)
storage.ftps: FTPS (encrypted FTP — needs an FTPS-capable server)
storage.emptyBody: Add a local folder, FTP server, or Synology NAS to send captured files to.
storage.encryptAtRestHint: Every file written to this connection is encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before being stored, and decrypted only when read back through the app. Applies to new files going forward — existing files already stored aren't retroactively re-encrypted.

storageRouting.title: Storage routing
storageRouting.explanation: Which storage connection each user's uploads go to — required before that user can upload anything from the mobile app.
storageRouting.createOneFirst: Create one on the Storage connections page first.
storageRouting.docTypesExplanation: Where each document type is saved, and how its folder path and filename are built from a template.

locations.title: Regions, cities & locations
locations.explanation: One shared directory, used as "Place" on calls/inventory and as "Organization" on phone book contacts. Regions also drive which technicians get notified about a new call (see Users).
locations.deleteRegionConfirm: Delete this region? Cities assigned to it must be removed first.
locations.deleteCityConfirm: Delete this city? Locations assigned to it must be removed first.
locations.mainWarehousesExplanation: These are the default stock locations used when registering new equipment and when searching for equipment while filling out a regular delivery note. Other locations still have their own independent warehouse, but aren't used as a default.
locations.portalExplanation: Generate a link for a location's client to check their service-call status — no login required. Revoking invalidates the link immediately.
locations.revokePortalConfirm: Revoke this client portal link? The current link will stop working immediately.

demoNotice.title: This is a demo installation
demoNotice.intro: You're using Vixor ERP in demo mode to explore its features — not for real business data. Please don't enter real client information, real financial data, or anything you need to keep.
demoNotice.disabled1: Calendar sync, order-intake email, and document-sending email settings
demoNotice.disabled3: New accounts default to limited permissions set by the super-admin
demoNotice.deletionWarning: Everything you create here — calls, orders, quotes, invoices, delivery notes, contacts, locations, warehouse items, vehicles — is automatically and permanently deleted 10 days after it's created.

wizard.welcomeBody: Let's get your installation set up — a few short steps: your profile, the organization, a user group, your first team members, calendar sync, document storage, and how your PDFs look. Everything here can be changed later from Settings.
wizard.profileBody: This is your own account — the person managing the whole installation. Fill in what you'd like others to see; you can leave anything blank and fill it in later.
wizard.orgBody: An organization is the company/business using Vixor — its own users, data, and settings, kept completely separate from any other organization on this installation.
wizard.orgNameRequired: Please enter a name for the organization.
wizard.groupBody: A group is a reusable set of permissions — instead of configuring access for every person one by one, assign them to a group and manage permissions for everyone at once from the Groups page.
wizard.groupNameRequired: Please enter a name for the group.
wizard.usersBody: Create accounts for the people who'll actually use the app day to day. You can add as many as you like now, or skip this and add them later from the Users page.
wizard.calendarBody: Connect a Google Calendar so scheduled calls and maintenance visits show up automatically — this opens in a new tab since it needs to sign in with Google. Come back here (or just close this and continue from Settings) once you're done, or skip it for now.
wizard.storageBody: Where generated PDFs (delivery notes, quotes, invoices) get saved — a local folder on this server, or a remote FTP/SFTP/Synology location. You can add more storage connections later and route different document types to different ones.
wizard.templatesBody: Pick the visual style for quotes, invoices, and delivery notes. You can change this anytime from each document type's settings page, and even switch per document type later.
wizard.doneBody: Your installation is ready to use. You can re-open this wizard anytime from the Settings menu if you want to revisit any of these steps.

appPasswordHelp.title: How to get an App Password
appPasswordHelp.step1: Sign in to the Google account you want to send from.
appPasswordHelp.step2: Turn on 2-Step Verification for that account, if it isn't already on — the App Passwords section won't appear in Google's settings without it.
appPasswordHelp.step4: Create a new app password (any name works, e.g. "Vixor").
appPasswordHelp.step5: Google shows the password as 16 characters, usually grouped like "xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx".
appPasswordHelp.step6: Copy it straight from Google (spaces and all) and paste it here — the spaces are removed automatically. Just don’t paste your regular Google account password instead.
appPasswordHelp.step7: Try creating a new quote/invoice and check the client's email.

prices.explainer: A reusable catalog of devices and services with standard prices — pick one when adding a line to a quote, invoice, or delivery note to fill in the description and price automatically. You can still edit or replace anything afterward.

payments.title: Payments
payments.simulatorDisclaimer: Payments are simulated — no real payment gateway is connected. Recording one here does not move real money; it's the final record confirming a document chain is fully closed out.

creditNotes.title: Credit Notes
creditNotes.legalNotice: A credit note (זיכוי) is the only legal way to correct or void an issued invoice — it never edits or deletes the original.

debitNotes.title: Debit Notes
debitNotes.legalNotice: A debit note (הודעת חיוב) increases what a client owes on an already-issued invoice — the original invoice is never edited.
debitNotes.pickInvoiceLabel: Which invoice does this relate to?

returns.title: Returns
returns.legalNotice: A return documents goods/equipment coming back from a client, referencing the delivery note they were sent out on.
returns.pickNoteLabel: Which delivery note were these items sent out on?
returns.restockHint: Link to a warehouse item to automatically add this quantity back into stock

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.disclaimer: A simplified starting chart of accounts and auto-posted ledger — not a complete accounting system. Have an accountant review before relying on this for tax filings.
accounting.noAccounts: No accounts yet — click "Add default accounts" to get started.
accounting.doesNotBalance: Assets do not equal Liabilities + Equity — check for a posting error.

taxAuthority.title: Tax Authority (Invoice Israel)
taxAuthority.disclaimer: This connects to Israel's Tax Authority "Invoice Israel" (חשבונית ישראל) system to obtain allocation numbers for eligible invoices. Requires signing up separately at the Tax Authority's developer portal — this only integrates with that account, it doesn't create one for you.
taxAuthority.softwareRegistrationHint: Leave blank to use your VAT number instead
taxAuthority.thresholdHint: Invoices above this amount request an allocation number. Verify this against the Tax Authority's current published threshold — it has changed faster than originally scheduled.
taxAuthority.clientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the existing value
taxAuthority.oauthScopeHint: Find this on your app's page in the Tax Authority developer portal
taxAuthority.connectedSuccess: Successfully connected to the Tax Authority.
taxAuthority.noOrganization: This account isn't assigned to a specific organization (super-admin) — switch to a tenant-scoped account to manage its Tax Authority settings.

home.title: What would you like to do?
home.tilesHint: Pick a category above to see what's inside.

currency.title: Currency Exchange Rates
currency.disclaimer: Rates are fetched daily from the Bank of Israel's public API. This integration hasn't been verified against a live response yet — if a rate looks wrong, add a manual override below; it takes priority over the automatic one for that date.
currency.empty: No rates recorded yet for this currency.

templateDesigner.title: Document Designer
templateDesigner.disclaimer: Colors and logo/company-info placement here apply to every document type (quotes, invoices, delivery notes, etc.) regardless of which of the 9 templates each one uses — this is your brand's look, not a per-document setting.
templateDesigner.colorsHint: Leave a color unset to use the chosen template's own default palette.
templateDesigner.layoutHint: Drag the boxes below to reposition. Drag the small circle to resize the logo.
templateDesigner.dragHint: Changes save automatically when you release.
templateDesigner.chooseTemplate: Choose a template to preview and customize

backup.title: Backups
backup.disclaimer: Backups are encrypted at rest on the server (same key as every other secret in this app). Downloaded files are decrypted for you automatically — 'Save As' gives you a ready-to-use .sql.gz, not something requiring the server's encryption key.
backup.confirmDelete: Delete backup {{filename}}? This cannot be undone.
backup.retentionHint: Older scheduled backups beyond this count are deleted automatically. 0 = keep all. Backups you create manually via "Create now" are never auto-deleted.
backup.restoreConfirmBody: This will DELETE everything currently in the database and replace it with the contents of {{filename}}. Anything created or changed since that backup was taken will be lost. This cannot be undone.
backup.mergeTitle: Restore from a device file (safe merge)
backup.mergeHint: Adds anything missing from this file — existing data is never deleted or overwritten, only rows that don't already exist get added.
backup.mergeConfirm: Merge in the contents of {{filename}}? Existing data will not be touched — only missing rows will be added.
backup.mergeSuccess: Merge complete — {{count}} insert statements processed (rows already present were skipped automatically).

timeThresholds.title: Time Thresholds
timeThresholds.disclaimer: These control the yellow/red color-coding used throughout the app — the whole card/row, not just a small dot — for calls, vehicle inspections, and equipment rentals as they approach their deadline.
timeThresholds.noOrgContext: Sign in as a user assigned to a specific organization to configure its time thresholds — a super-admin account isn't tied to any single one.

rentals.title: Rentals
rentals.confirmReturn: Mark this rental as returned? Stock will be restored.
rentals.clientSearchHint: Search phone book, or type a new name…
rentals.formInvalid: Pick equipment, enter a client name, and a due date.

dataMigration.title: Data Migration
dataMigration.importHint: Bring in customer/supplier data from another program, like Chashbashevet (חשבשבת)
dataMigration.exportHint: Save your data out to a common file format (Excel, CSV, or JSON)
dataMigration.step0Title: How to get a file from חשבשבת
dataMigration.step0Instr1: Open חשבשבת and go to the customer/supplier list you want to export (תוכנית → אינדקס כרטיסים — the account index screen).
dataMigration.step0Instr2: Choose the export option and save it as an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file to your computer — not the native movein.dat accounting-journal format, which has no name/phone/contact data in it at all.
dataMigration.step0Instr3: Note where the file was saved (usually your Downloads folder) — you'll need to pick it in the next step.
dataMigration.step0Instr4: Come back here and continue to choose that file.
dataMigration.step0Hint: If your version of חשבשבת only offers the movein.dat journal-entry format, this wizard will still recognize it and explain the right export option to use instead.
dataMigration.step1Hint: Click below and pick the Excel or CSV file you exported.
dataMigration.moveinDetectedTitle: This is a חשבשבת accounting journal file (MOVEIN)
dataMigration.needNamePhone: Name and phone are required — map at least those two columns.

taxAuthorityExport.title: Tax Authority Export
taxAuthorityExport.disclaimer: Generates the "Uniform Structure" file (קובץ במבנה אחיד) required for the Tax Authority's software registry — covers invoices, ledger transactions, chart of accounts, and inventory for the selected date range.
taxAuthorityExport.simulatorNote: Registration status pending — this file hasn't been validated against the Tax Authority's own online simulator (סימולטור) yet. Run it there before relying on this for an actual registration submission or audit request.
taxAuthorityExport.pickOrgFirst: Choose which organization to generate this export for.

bankData.title: Bank Data
bankData.banksHint: {{count}} banks — used everywhere a bank is picked (payments, expenses, settings). This list is built in and doesn't need updating.
bankData.howToGetFile: The full branch list (~1,400 rows) isn't built in — it's too large to keep accurate by hand. Import it from a downloadable spreadsheet instead:
bankData.step1: Download a bank-branch registry file (CSV or Excel) — Bank of Israel and several accounting reference sites publish one.
bankData.step2: Make sure it has columns for bank (name or code), branch number, branch name, and city — column order doesn't matter, they're matched automatically.
bankData.step3: Upload it below. Re-uploading later (e.g. an updated file) is safe — existing branches get updated, not duplicated.
bankData.chooseCsv: Choose a CSV or Excel file
